testCases.title: Happy path facility & admin onboarding
steps: Navigate to /auth/register-facility
Fill facilityName='CHC Baripada Regional Hub', facilityType='CHC', district='Mayurbhanj', state='Odisha'
Fill adminFullName='Dr. Pradeep Mohanty', adminPhoneNumber='+919876543210', adminEmail='admin.baripada@health.gov.in', adminPassword='AdminPass@2026'
Click button[type='submit'] ('Complete Facility Registration')
Wait for HTTP 201 response
expected: Success card renders with checkmark
Displays facility name, generated facility code (FAC-CHC-XXXX), and admin name
Captures facilityCode and facilityPublicId for subsequent tests

testCases.title: Validation: Missing required facility name
steps: Navigate to /auth/register-facility
Leave facilityName empty, fill other required fields
Click Complete Facility Registration
expected: Red error banner appears with message 'Facility Name is required.'
No network request dispatched

testCases.title: Validation: Invalid E.164 phone number formats
steps: Enter invalid phone formats: '98765', '+91-98765-43210', 'alphabetic'
Attempt submission
expected: Error alert appears requiring E.164 format: ^\+?[1-9]\d{9,14}$

testCases.title: Validation: Password shorter than 8 characters
steps: Fill all fields, set password to 'pass123' (7 characters)
Attempt submission
expected: Error alert appears: 'Admin password must be at least 8 characters long.'

testCases.title: Facility type selection coverage (PHC, CHC, CLINIC, CAMP, DISTRICT_HOSPITAL)
steps: Iterate through all 5 options in select[name='facilityType']
Verify DOM selection and network payload serialization
expected: All 5 types are accepted by form and serialized properly

testCases.title: Password mask visibility toggle
steps: Type password into input[name='adminPassword']
Click eye icon button to toggle to plaintext
Click eye icon again to toggle back to password mask
expected: Input type switches between 'password' and 'text'

testCases.title: Navigation: Return to Sign In screen
steps: Click back arrow link in header or 'Sign in to existing facility' footer link
expected: Browser navigates to /auth/login cleanly

testCases.title: One-click workstation launch from success card
steps: Complete TC-ONB-001 to reach success card
Click 'Launch Facility Workstation' button
expected: Redirects to /dashboard with active Admin session and newly registered facility selected

testCases.title: Invite Medical Officer (Doctor)
steps: Navigate to /settings as Administrator
Enter Full Name: 'Dr. Ananya Ray', Email: 'dr.ananya.ray@health.gov.in', Phone: '+919876543220', Role: 'DOCTOR'
Click 'Send Invitation via API'
expected: HTTP request to /staff/invite with ADMIN bearer token
Success banner appears with clickable direct activation link
New row added to 'Pending & Invited Staff' list

testCases.title: Invite Staff Nurse (Triage Officer)
steps: Fill Name: 'Sunita Barik', Email: 'sunita.nurse@health.gov.in', Phone: '+919876543221', Role: 'NURSE'
Submit invitation
expected: Success confirmation displays
Staff list shows role NURSE with activation link

testCases.title: Invite Community Health Officer (CHO)
steps: Fill Name: 'Ramesh Chandra Patra', Email: 'ramesh.cho@health.gov.in', Phone: '+919876543222', Role: 'HEALTH_WORKER'
Submit invitation
expected: Staff list shows role HEALTH_WORKER with activation link

testCases.title: Validation: Missing name or email in staff invite
steps: Leave name empty and submit
expected: Error alert: 'Please provide both staff member name and official email address.'

testCases.title: Pending staff list persistence across reload
steps: Invite a staff member, then reload browser page
expected: Pending & Invited Staff list retains previously invited members

testCases.title: RBAC demo role switcher updates
steps: Click role buttons: Doctor, Nurse, Admin, CHO
Observe Topbar dropdown value
expected: Active user role updates instantly in Topbar and application context

testCases.title: Backend API Connectivity Ping probe
steps: Locate Backend API Connectivity card
Click 'Ping' button
expected: Ping icon animates and service status updates with live latency (ms)

testCases.title: Happy path staff account activation via invite URL
steps: Open activation URL from Suite 02
Verify token is prefilled in input
Enter OTP: '123456', Password: 'DoctorPass@2026', Confirm: 'DoctorPass@2026'
Click 'Activate Account & Proceed'
expected: HTTP 201 response with accessToken and refreshToken
Success screen displays 'Account Activated!'
Redirects to /dashboard and stores token in localStorage

testCases.title: Manual token entry without URL query parameter
steps: Navigate directly to /auth/activate
Type token, OTP, and matching passwords
Submit
expected: Activation proceeds normally

testCases.title: Validation: Missing or short OTP (< 4 digits)
steps: Enter token, enter OTP '12', enter passwords
Submit
expected: Alert displays: 'Please enter the one-time verification code (OTP).'

testCases.title: Validation: Password confirmation mismatch
steps: Enter password 'FirstPass@123' and confirm 'SecondPass@123'
Submit
expected: Alert displays: 'Passwords do not match. Please re-enter.'

testCases.title: Validation: Password shorter than 8 characters
steps: Enter password 'short' (5 chars)
Submit
expected: Alert displays: 'Password must be at least 8 characters long.'

testCases.title: Form login with staff email/password
steps: Navigate to /auth/login
Enter email: 'dr.sharma@health.gov.in', password: 'DoctorPassword@123'
Click 'Sign in'
expected: Navigates to /dashboard with Doctor profile active

testCases.title: Quick demo provider logins (Doctor & Nurse)
steps: Click 'Sign in as Sunita B. (Triage Nurse)' button
expected: Instant redirect to /dashboard with Nurse role

testCases.title: Validation: Empty credentials
steps: Leave email and password empty, click 'Sign in'
expected: Alert displays: 'We couldn't sign you in. Check your staff ID and password and try again.'

testCases.title: Background scene toggle (CHC vs Network Hospital)
steps: Click background toggle button in login header
expected: Background artwork transitions smoothly between clinic and hospital views

testCases.title: Links: Register Facility and Activate Staff Account
steps: Click 'Register Facility' link
Verify route /auth/register-facility
Go back and click 'Activate Staff Account' link
Verify route /auth/activate
expected: Both links navigate to their respective pages cleanly

testCases.title: Step 1: Demographics and clinical consent
steps: Fill Patient Name: 'Bimala Naik', Age: '48', Gender: 'Female', Language: 'Odia'
Enter Chief Complaint: 'Fever for 4 days with dry cough'
Check consent box and click 'Continue to Ingestion Studio'
expected: Transitions smoothly to Step 2

testCases.title: Consent modal inspection and agreement
steps: Click 'Review Consent Terms & ABDM Privacy Safeguards'
Click 'I Agree & Provide Consent' inside modal
expected: Modal closes and consent checkbox on main form is checked

testCases.title: Step 2A: Voice intake recording and transcript review
steps: Select Voice Intake Studio, record for 3 seconds, click stop
expected: Waveform animates, transcript renders in original language and English toggle

testCases.title: Step 2B: Lab report OCR extraction table
steps: Select Lab Report OCR Studio, click 'Load Benchmark CBC Report'
expected: Document preview loads sample_report.svg and extracted facts table populates with confidence scores

testCases.title: Step 3: Physiological vitals measurement entry
steps: Click 'Generate AI Triage Summary'
expected: Vitals validated, transitions to Step 4

testCases.title: Step 4: AI triage synthesis and submission to queue
steps: Review generated draft note and protocol cues
Click 'Submit to Clinical Review Queue'
expected: Case appended to queue, navigates to /queue with new patient visible

testCases.title: Queue table columns verification
steps: Inspect column headers for Token, Demographics, Complaint, Risk Signs, Priority, Status, Actions
expected: All standard triage columns are visible

testCases.title: Filter by Priority: RED, YELLOW, GREEN, and ALL
steps: Click 'Red (Urgent)' -> verify only RED cases visible
Click 'Yellow (Prompt)' -> verify only YELLOW cases visible
Click 'Green (Routine)' -> verify only GREEN cases visible
Click 'All' -> verify full queue restored
expected: Filtering updates instantly without page reload

testCases.title: Search patient by name or ID (P-1042)
steps: Type 'P-1042' in search bar
expected: Exactly row P-1042 is displayed

testCases.title: Zero search results empty state artwork
steps: Search 'NONEXISTENT999'
expected: Empty state illustration (empty_queue.png) renders with clear explanation

testCases.title: Clinical workspace header & vitals banner
steps: Open /patients/P-1042
Verify patient header displays vital signs and risk tags
expected: Vitals bar renders BP, Pulse, Temp, SpO2, RR accurately

testCases.title: Edit clinical fact value and record audit entry
steps: Click Edit on Hemoglobin fact, change 11.2 to 11.8, save
expected: Fact displays 11.8 g/dL with 'Edited' badge
Audit trail logs EDIT_FACT with clinician name

testCases.title: Answer AI protocol clarification question
steps: Click 'No Prior Asthma' option on AI question
expected: Option marked as selected, timestamp recorded

testCases.title: Resolve missing information item
steps: Enter resolution in 'Last meal / fluid intake time' and save
expected: Item updates to OBTAINED state with green checkmark

testCases.title: Physician priority reclassification (YELLOW to RED)
steps: Change priority dropdown from YELLOW to RED with rationale
expected: Priority badge updates to RED, audit entry recorded

testCases.title: Physician triage note sign-off and finalization
steps: Click 'Approve & Finalize Triage Note', confirm in dialog
expected: Case status updates to REVIEWED / APPROVED, signoff timestamp locked

testCases.title: Open referral modal and dispatch emergency transfer
steps: Click 'Refer to Higher Facility'
Enter Target: 'District Hospital Baripada', Urgency: 'IMMEDIATE', Rationale: 'Acute respiratory failure'
Click 'Confirm & Dispatch Referral'
expected: Referral dispatched, patient status updates to REFERRED, audit trail logged

testCases.title: Validation: Missing clinical rationale
steps: Leave rationale empty and submit referral
expected: Submission blocked with validation alert

testCases.title: Toggle offline mode simulation
steps: Click Offline toggle in Topbar
Verify amber badge and local storage routing
expected: Offline state active without page reload

testCases.title: Prototype data reset
steps: Click 'Reset Demo' in top disclaimer banner
expected: Restores all cases and facts to default benchmark state

testCases.title: Rapid double-click submission protection
steps: Rapidly click submit button multiple times
expected: Button disabled after first click, exactly one network call sent

testCases.title: Unicode and Indic script character support
steps: Enter Odia script name: 'ବିମଳା ନାୟକ'
expected: Name rendered in clean Odia typography without corruption

testCases.title: Responsive viewport check (375x812, 768x1024, 1440x900)
steps: Resize browser viewport across mobile, tablet, and desktop
expected: Layout adapts without horizontal overflow
